Created by FontForge 20090914 at Fri Oct 13 00:34:12 2017 By www-data In memory of Shmuel Katz (August 18, 1926 - March 26, 2010) the Israeli artist, ilustrator and cartoonist. This font is inspired by the letter forms of his hand drawn "Passover Hagadah" for the Kibutzim.
